display_name: Patient Health Questionnaire (PHQ)-8: Total Score (sum of 8 items)
description:
Total score is the sum of the 8 items. A score of 10 or greater is considered major depression, 20 or more is severe major depression. [Kroenke K et al. 2001 (PubMED ID: 11556941)](10.1046/j.1525-1497.2001.016009606.x)

External semantic reference: [Search for all PHQ-8 variables within this dataset](https://sleepdata.org/loftdatasets/lofthf/variables?search=phq8)
